result.label: blue ice
result.description: Ancient water ice compressed so long and so clean that it is finally, truly blue in the body -- the one thing in the Blue Desert that is not a trick of scattering. Cut into it and the wall face weeps cold light for a moment before it goes dark again. RimMandrake: Baroque Biomes

result.label: blue-ice cold rack
result.description: An open steel rack packed with blocks of blue ice. It needs no power: while the room is warmer than its setting, the ice slowly soaks up the heat and melts, so a hold stays cold through a blackout and warms by degrees instead of all at once. The blocks cloud from deep blue to white as the cold runs out, the rack groans as they settle, and the melt drips into sealed cans of clean water. It does nothing outdoors. RimMandrake: Baroque Biomes

result.label: cold wax
result.description: A waxy hydrocarbon rendered from a Blue Desert native's fuel glands or gut-oil, or harvested straight from its fractal flora. Inert and stable in the cold; store or refine it anywhere warm and it will not stay inert for long. RimMandrake: Baroque Biomes

result.label: palefloss
result.description: A fist of transparent filaments hugging the ice, refracting what little light reaches this plateau into faint rainbows at the edges. The Blue Desert's sparse "grass" — and every strand of it a charge of liquid butane. RimMandrake: Baroque Biomes

result.label: glassfern
result.description: A hand-high fractal frond, all edge and refraction, branching into gas-exchange filaments in place of leaves. Staggeringly beautiful and stable only in the cold — warm it and it is a bomb with a growth ring. RimMandrake: Baroque Biomes

result.label: chimeglobe
result.description: A clear stalk carrying one spherical lattice head that sheds glittering seed-lattices to the wind. The single most beautiful thing on the plateau, and the biggest single charge among the flora — a chimeglobe going up restarts the whole field. RimMandrake: Baroque Biomes

result.label: virr
result.description: A hollow fractal tube, hand-high, branching into open-ended pipes of graded width -- an organ the wind plays. Fields of it are the biome's music between storms, and the pitch climbs as the charge inside ripens: a keen ear can hear which field is about to be dangerous to warm. RimMandrake: Baroque Biomes

result.label: qeshra
result.description: A knee-low cushion of glassy beads, each a translucent scarlet-to-tangerine sphere packed like roe on a clear stalk-mat, frost-rimmed at the edge. The one red thing on the plateau. The native grazers seek it out, and a patch draws a herd. RimMandrake: Baroque Biomes

result.label: kethevar
result.description: A hand-high spiral coil of pleated glassy ribbon, pale chartreuse-gold with a faint inner glitter. Harmless until killed: cut, it gives plain cold wax; set it alight or blast it and what is left is a silver-black lattice of pure carbon. RimMandrake: Baroque Biomes

result.label: lisqueth
result.description: A flat starburst rosette, waist-wide, of smoky-violet translucent ribs whose edges fluoresce a cool magenta-pink under starlight. Dim and never warm: the nightside's one natural lamp. RimMandrake: Baroque Biomes

result.label: vashpuk
result.description: A squat waist-high bladder of smoky honey-amber skin, a slow milky sediment swirling inside, ringed at the base by stubby clear feeder roots. Visibly full. Tap it and it gives up a great deal of cold wax, then slowly refills. Warm it and it is the biggest charge on the plateau after the chimeglobe. RimMandrake: Baroque Biomes
